heading: This Afternoon
text: Mostly sunny skies. Highs from the upper 50s to low 60s. Light and variable wind.

heading: Tonight
text: Mostly clear late, with clouds moving in from the south overnight. Lows from the upper 30s to low 40s. Light and variable wind.

heading: Sunday
text: Mostly cloudy, chance of rain showers along the VT MA border late in the day. Highs from the upper 50s, to near 60. Wind turning south at 5 to 10 mph.
